privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Local-first • Your data, your device
privacy.intro: MomAI is local-first. Everything you create stays on this device. Below is exactly what is stored, what is not, and how to export or delete your data.
privacy.stored.title: What is stored locally
privacy.stored.settings.title: Settings
privacy.stored.settings.desc: Your user_name, persona, and preferences. Synced via the node-core sidecar (single source of truth).
privacy.stored.chat.title: Chat history
privacy.stored.chat.desc: Threads and messages. Automatically pruned after 90 days of inactivity.
privacy.stored.notes.title: Notes
privacy.stored.notes.desc: Your notes, encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (key derived from safeStorage).
privacy.stored.reminders.title: Reminders
privacy.stored.reminders.desc: Tasks and agenda items. Inactive reminders are auto-purged after 30 days.
privacy.stored.observability.title: Observability metrics
privacy.stored.observability.desc: Local performance traces (cache/). Capped at the last 2,000 entries and never leaves the device.
privacy.notStored.title: What is NOT stored
privacy.notStored.telemetry.title: No analytics or telemetry
privacy.notStored.telemetry.desc: No usage events, no crash reports, no remote metrics. Logs are local only.
privacy.notStored.accounts.title: No user accounts
privacy.notStored.accounts.desc: MomAI is local-first. There is no account, no signup, no email or password on our servers.
privacy.notStored.tracking.title: No third-party tracking
privacy.notStored.tracking.desc: No Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel, no tracking SDKs. Nothing follows you across the web.
privacy.actions.title: Your data, your control
privacy.export.title: Export my data
privacy.export.desc: Download a ZIP archive with all data stored on this device.

notes.welcome.title: Welcome to Notes
notes.welcome.content:
# Notes Workspace
This is where MomAI keeps your structured memory.

## How it works
When you ask me to save something, I can create and organize notes for you here automatically.

## What you can do
- **Organize ideas:** Write with Markdown support, including headings, lists, and emphasis.
- **Drag and drop:** Import and export `.md` files using the folder button above.
- **Ask for summaries:** You can ask in chat things like "What do my notes say about X?" and I can summarize quickly.

> Tip: Right-click a note in the sidebar to rename it.

You're all set.

settings.privacy.resetAllDataDesc: Permanently delete all notes, history, sessions, and downloaded models stored on this device.
settings.privacy.confirmDescription: This will permanently delete your notes, history, sessions, and downloaded models. Your account with the MomAI service (if any) will not be affected.
settings.dev.resetDescription: This will permanently delete EVERYTHING: database, all messages, local LLMs, semantic index, cache, Python env, AND skill data (WhatsApp auth, contacts, history). You will need to re-scan the WhatsApp QR code after. The welcome screen will appear automatically. The skill code in the monorepo is preserved. This action cannot be undone.
